subject: general
question: If in a certain code language, DANCER is called TEACHER, TEACHER is called PILOT, PILOT is called LAWYER, LAWYER is called SINGER, and SINGER is called CHEF, then who practices law?
solution:
If in a certain code language, 

 
• DANCER is called TEACHER
 
• TEACHER is called PILOT
 
• PILOT is called LAWYER
 
• LAWYER is called SINGER
 
• SINGER is called CHEF

Lawyer practices law and LAWYER is called SINGER, so Singer is the one who practices law.

Hence, ‘**SINGER**’ is the correct answer.
